sentences.en: As he grew excited, he spoke more and more rapidly.
sentences.zh: 随着他变得越来越兴奋，他说得也越来越快。

sentences.en: Time passed rapidly and the work didn't advance at all.
sentences.zh: 时间飞逝，但工作一点进展都没有。

sentences.en: The number of wild boars is increasing rapidly in Germany.
sentences.zh: 德国野猪的数量正在迅速增加。
